entries.name: Starbucks eGift Card
entries.note: starbucks.com/gift does not print the dollar range; 2025 Starbucks press says most cards load $5–$100.

entries.name: Apple Gift Card
entries.note: Electronic gift cards $10–$2000; physical cards bought online are $25–$2000.

entries.name: Google Play Gift Card
entries.note: US official denominations are $10, $15, $25, $50, $100, plus variable $5–$200.

entries.name: Best Buy Gift Card
entries.note: BestBuy.com sells cards from $15 (smallest listed) through $500; a staff Q&A said online presets were $15–$200. The $500 Gamer card listing was marked no longer available in new condition when checked.

entries.name: Vanilla Visa Gift Card
entries.note: Purchase fee is extra and not included in giftMin/giftMax. Vanilla pages are JS-heavy; range is from Vanilla's $10–$500 amount picker copy.

entries.name: Netflix eGift Card
entries.note: Netflix does not sell cards on netflix.com; amounts are from Amazon, which Netflix lists as an online retailer. Walmart also sells $30/$60/$100 eGifts.

entries.name: Spotify Gift Card
entries.note: Spotify no longer sells cards on spotify.com. Target lists $10, $12, $36, $60, $72, and $99; Kroger eGifts are $10/$30/$60. Range is retailer denominations, not a custom amount.

entries.name: Steam Gift Card
entries.note: Steam's own add-funds / digital gift amounts shown are $5, $10, $25, and $50. Retail physical cards commonly go to $100; Steam's gift-card select page did not print a max.

entries.name: PlayStation Store Gift Card
entries.note: PlayStation.com says you can customize value via CashStar but does not print the range; authorized eGift sellers list $10–$100.

entries.name: Xbox Gift Card
entries.note: Microsoft Store page defaults to $100; Microsoft Q&A for the same product says US digital cards are $1–$100, with $1 increments up to $80.

entries.name: Nintendo eShop Gift Card
entries.note: nintendo.com does not list denominations. Nintendo-sold US digital codes on Amazon include $5, $10, $20, $50, $65, $70, and $100. Some third-party eCash listings go to $200.

entries.name: Uber Gift Card
entries.note: Uber.com says store cards start at $15 and an account can hold $2,000 total; it does not print a per-card max. Authorized eGift retailers (e.g. Kroger/eGifter) sell $15–$500 per card.

entries.name: Sephora eGift Card
entries.note: Sephora FAQ states a $250 max denomination; $10 min is from Sephora corporate gift cards ($10–$250) and authorized eGift amount pickers, not printed on the consumer FAQ.

entries.name: Home Depot eGift Card
entries.note: Official Home Depot eGift partner page lists $5–$2,000. homedepot.com FAQ confirms eGift purchase but does not print the range.

entries.name: Airbnb Gift Card
entries.note: airbnb.com/giftcards says pick an amount but does not print the range. Airbnb's gift-card purchase flow (Launch Gift Cards) asks for $25–$2,000.

entries.name: Chipotle eGift Card
entries.note: chipotle.com/gift-cards does not print amounts. Chipotle's gift-card FAQ says $10 min and $250 max per card.

entries.name: Lyft Gift Card
entries.note: lyft.com says select $25–$100 or enter your own amount. Lyft also sends buyers to Amazon, where the eGift custom range is $25–$200.

entries.name: Instacart Gift Card
entries.note: Current help page confirms preset or custom amounts but does not print the range. Instacart's gift-card blog says presets $25–$200 and custom up to $500.
